description: Get API Keys - Retrieve all API keys for the account. For security, returned keys are masked (only the first and last 3 characters are shown, e.g. 'abc...xyz') — full key values are never exposed by this tool. To view or copy a full key, the account holder must use the API-key management page in the SalesBlink app (see get_api_key_page_link/get_api_key_refresh_link for a login link).

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: get_api_keys

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.
